title: The Yacht Life
description:
S01 E06 — The Arnold's \"A-Sea\"
In Knoxville, Tennessee, Captain Boomies joins the Arnold family for a very special maiden voyage; laying eyes on their yacht for the first time-custom-built to match their private jet, it's a big moment.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E01 — NYC Family Home: Homeworthy Founders
Homeworthy founders Alison Kenworthy and Michael Koenigs open the door to the once-empty white-box apartment; a year later it has been transformed with a kitchen designed for gathering, a tranquil bedroom retreat, and a charming room for their kids.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E04 — Eclectic Louisiana Home of Textile Designer Rebecca Vizard
Journey to the Louisiana Delta for a look inside the home of Rebecca Vizard; from rooms draped in rich historic textiles to a whimsical "movie wagon" repurposed from a trailer base, Rebecca's creative spirit thrives in every corner of the house.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E01 — Mystery Unlocked
Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E02 — Raising the Bar
On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E03 — Chic Hacks: Style, Flights & Gluten-Free Delights
Stylist Chellie Carlson shows Sabrina tricks for leveling up her wardrobe, cookbook author Danielle Walker spices things up in the kitchen, and comedienne Trish Suhr delivers laughs and next-level travel hacks that'll have you packing like a pro.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E04 — The High Low Life
Trainer Keon Dorsey brings the burn, stylist Caroline Baudino shows how to look ultra-chic on a budget, and journalist Natalie Morales wraps it up with an impressive, budget-friendly dinner you can make in no time.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E05 — Stars & Celebrations
Eden Passante drops by with pro tips for entertaining, Matthew Hoffman gets a crash course on crafting the perfect home scent, and Danielle Page reveals how to embrace your zodiac sign; it's a masterclass in hosting, ambiance, and cosmic vibes.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E06 — Design Your Life, Build Your Wealth, Love Your Skin
Small changes can create a big ripple effect in your daily life; Pattie Ehsaei tackles the tricky topic of finances, Bobby Berk steps in to transform Sabrina's most high-traffic home spaces, and Dr. Sugai spills pro tips and beauty secrets.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E01 — We Turned a Blank Room Into a Dream Studio
Kylie Katich helps her best friend Hayley turn her blank room into a warm, personality-packed podcast studio; from custom curtain tracks and gallery walls to cozy furniture, the makeover gives Hayley a space that finally feels completely her own.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E02 — Rustic Meets Refined
Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E03 — This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E04 — Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E05 — We Built the Ultimate Home Gym
Kylie transforms Mike and Tay's unfinished workout room into a sleek, motivating home gym complete with smart storage solutions; what starts with Grinch-green walls becomes a bright, elevated space built for serious workouts and serious style.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E09 — An Eclectic Brooklyn Townhouse Defined by Fashion
Travel to Brooklyn to visit the vibrant townhouse of multidisciplinary artists Skylar Marshai and Temi Ibisanmi; featuring a vinyl room, curated treasures and a striking collection of artwork, every space reflects their eye for fashion and color.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E10 — A Converted Boathouse Becomes a Beautiful Home on Nantucket
Step inside designer Gary McBournie and Bill Richards's Nantucket oceanside escape; see the boat shed transformed into a breezy summer sanctuary perfect for entertaining; every corner is infused with a sophisticated yet delightful nautical flair.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E07 — Meadows and Modernism
Levi visits two retreats that celebrate open spaces and minimalist design; he starts at the Alto A-Frame, an elevated architectural gem nestled beside a creek; next, he tours the Timber Haus, a Scandinavian-inspired stay tucked in a field of florals.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E03 — Tracks and Tranquility
Levi travels the countryside to see two historic railcars transformed into stationary sanctuaries; first, he arrives in Deary, Idaho, to step inside a restored 1909 carriage; next, Levi heads to Long Lane, Missouri, to tour a 1928 Luxury Railcar.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S05 E11 — Tiny Treehouse Overlooks; A Tiny Frame of Mind
Levi returns to Hocking Hills, Ohio to visit the small but mighty Pinnacle A-Frame built on stilts at the base of a hillside; Levi visits Timbery Tiny House, a handcrafted timber frame refuge in Athens, Vermont.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E01 — Heights of the Evergreen State
Levi heads to Issaquah at Ananda, a modern sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, overlooking the Raging River; next, he travels to Ashford to visit Treehouse Mt. Rainier, a rustic-elegant escape supported entirely by eight towering trees.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E05 — Peaks of Ringgold
Levi travels to Ringgold, Georgia, to experience two towering stays; first, he scales the Selah Ridge Watchtower, a 35-foot-tall sanctuary; just a short hike away is the Selah Ridge Treehouse, a B&B that takes the tiny stay concept to new heights.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E01 — Desert Beginnings
DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E02 — Concrete Chaos & Joshua Tree Charm
Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E03 — Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E04 — Living With Leo
Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E02 — Chris Scott: A Top Chef Talks Biscuits, Jazz and Aprons
Chef Chris Scott, Top Chef finalist, restaurateur, and author, welcomes Matthew into his bucolic New Jersey home for an afternoon filled with flavor, fascinating stories, and a deep dive into Chris's legendary biscuit recipe.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E04 — Melba Wilson: A Harlem Icon
Chef, restaurateur, and author Melba Wilson schools Matthew on the art of her legendary shrimp and grits; with laughter, flavor, and zero room for dessert, this visit is an unforgettable taste of Harlem's finest and most original.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E06 — Fariyal Abdullahi: From Ethiopia to the Met Gala
Matthew meets culinary powerhouse and Ethiopian-born Chef Fariyal Abdullahi for an exclusive tour of Hav & Mar, the sizzling seafood spot where she is the Executive Chef and gets a hands-on lesson in creating their signature dish, Doro Wat.

S06 E01 — It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E11 — A Designer's Zen in the Zone
Designer Nikki Baize is a woman of many talents and her home is a bold blend of all the things she loves: grounded in Asian influences, rich in Wabi-Sabi philosophy, and bursting with color.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E10 — Maximal Style in the Marshes
In this South Carolina stunner, designer Mary Welch Fox turns up the volume on style with bold choices, fearless edge, and serious design swagger; this home doesn't just bend the rules-it breaks them wide open.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E09 — One-of-a-Kind Cotton Mill Loft
Robert MacNeill opens the doors to his one-of-a-kind home-a converted loft inside an 1892 cotton mill that's anything but ordinary; with towering ceilings and massive factory windows, it's a stunning blend of historic charm and modern vision.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E08 — Stunning Southern Modern Manor
In this North Carolina dream home, designer Don Massenburg delivers a masterclass in color, texture, and next-level style including a hidden pantry so chic, it might just be the crown jewel of the kitchen, if not the home.

title: The Reveal
description:
S05 E07 — Coloring Outside the Classic Cottage

Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E06 — Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E05 — From Cats to Co-Living: A Place for Everyone
Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E04 — Once Upon a Time: Fairy Tale Homes
Jillian explores some of the most whimsical homes in Southern California: the famed Hobbit Apartments in Culver City, a home built into a bridge, and a historic Storybook home filled with charm and a storied past.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E03 — Off-Grid Living: The Creative Space

Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E02 — Rustic Meets Refined
Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E01 — We Turned a Blank Room Into a Dream Studio
Kylie Katich helps her best friend Hayley turn her blank room into a warm, personality-packed podcast studio; from custom curtain tracks and gallery walls to cozy furniture, the makeover gives Hayley a space that finally feels completely her own.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E03 — This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E04 — Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E05 — We Built the Ultimate Home Gym
Kylie transforms Mike and Tay's unfinished workout room into a sleek, motivating home gym complete with smart storage solutions; what starts with Grinch-green walls becomes a bright, elevated space built for serious workouts and serious style.

title: The Vision Maker
description:
S01 E04 — Sabrina's Scandinavian Bedroom Sanctuary; Jennie's Butterflies & Blush Nursery
Dancer Sabrina wants her awkward flex space transformed into a bedroom sanctuary with an open view of her gorgeous backyard; Jennie and her husband are eager to design their guest room into the ideal nursery for their first child.

title: The Vision Maker
description:
S01 E05 — Laura's Outdoor Dreamscape; Julie's Reclaimed Refuge
Anne-Marie designs an outdoor dreamscape for luxury realtor Laura; Anne-Marie proposes a wellness room for Julie's reclaimed bedroom.

title: The Vision Maker
description:
S01 E06 — Skylar & Tyler's Blank Bungalow / Melissa's Galley Kitchen Glow Up
Anne-Marie shares her vision for the family room and kitchen of Skylar and Tyler's new bungalow home; Melissa wants to make the galley kitchen of her two-bedroom condo more functional and modern.

title: The Vision Maker
description:
S01 E01 — Ruby's Kitchen With a View & Pon and Garmen's Lost Living Room
Anne-Marie shares her vision to transform Ruby's kitchen into a space devoid of its traditional kitchen-like appearance; aiming to establish a warmer and more organic atmosphere that seamlessly flows into the adjacent great room and dining area.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E06 — Fariyal Abdullahi: From Ethiopia to the Met Gala
Matthew meets culinary powerhouse and Ethiopian-born Chef Fariyal Abdullahi for an exclusive tour of Hav & Mar, the sizzling seafood spot where she is the Executive Chef and gets a hands-on lesson in creating their signature dish, Doro Wat.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E05 — Burgers and Babka: Viral Sensations
Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E04 — Melba Wilson: A Harlem Icon
Chef, restaurateur, and author Melba Wilson schools Matthew on the art of her legendary shrimp and grits; with laughter, flavor, and zero room for dessert, this visit is an unforgettable taste of Harlem's finest and most original.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E03 — Carnie Wilson: Rock Royalty's Infamous Mac and Cheese
Matthew gets an all-access pass to rock royalty when he visits Carnie Wilson's Los Angeles home for a tour of her music studio and to whip up her Fall-to-Your-Knees Mac and Cheese while sharing laughs, stories, and even a little harmonizing.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E02 — Chris Scott: A Top Chef Talks Biscuits, Jazz and Aprons
Chef Chris Scott, Top Chef finalist, restaurateur, and author, welcomes Matthew into his bucolic New Jersey home for an afternoon filled with flavor, fascinating stories, and a deep dive into Chris's legendary biscuit recipe.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E03 — This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E04 — Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E01 — Mystery Unlocked
Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E02 — Raising the Bar
On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E05 — Designed to Dine
Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E05 — Southern Heritage: A Timeless Georgia Estate
Join Terri Woodall and former NFL player Lee Woodall for an inside look at their home in Georgia; known as the Healing House, this residence serves as a sanctuary for the community, continuing a legacy of service built into its foundation.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E06 — Cozy and Chic California Cottage
Interior designer Leslie Martin welcomes us into her beach cottage; from the bustling, texture-rich kitchen to the cleverly utilized living spaces, the cottage radiates a warmth that belies its modest square footage.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E04 — Eduardo & Gabriela's Guest Retreat
Eduardo and Gabriela's "little" home projects have piled up; with their grown son's room ready to become a guest retreat, an unfinished wallpaper job in the laundry room, and shades waiting to be hung, they're ready for Drew's help.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E05 — Jack & Tyler's Colorful Curb Appeal
Jack and Tyler found their dream home with the perfect yard; they've made the inside picture-perfect, but now it's time for the exterior to shine; Drew helps repaint the fence, upgrade the front door, and add a few final touches indoors.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E06 — Kayla & Ryan's Toddler To-Do List
Kayla and Ryan are managing a newborn and a toddler, plus the aftermath of tornado damage, which means they need both functionality and style in their space; Drew jumps in, delivering the family-friendly upgrades that they desperately need.

title: Extravagant Spaces
description:
S01 E01 — The Paradise Valley Global Ranch & the 64,000-Foot Ranch
Kelli joins Mark Candelaria and designer Wendy Black Rodgers on a tour of a home bejeweled with lighting and accents from the owner's worldwide travels.

title: Extravagant Spaces
description:
S01 E03 — The Arizona Villa Imported From Italy & the English Manor
Kelli is transported to an Italian villa without leaving Arizona; from the marble-adorned courtyard to the magnificent pools and bocce court, this home is an homage to everything Italian.

title: Extravagant Spaces
description:
S01 E05 — The Home Carved Into the Side of a Mountain and the Ultimate Entertainer's Retreat
Kelli discovers the ultimate entertainer's retreat as she joins Mark Candelaria for a tour of the Italian-inspired villa.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E04 — Innovation and Inlets
Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays; he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home; then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E02 — Hocking Hills Hideaways
Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E06 — Geometric Gems and Storybook Stays
Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E08 — Ridge-Top Rituals and Riverfront Rejuvenation
In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E03 — Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E04 — Living With Leo
Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E05 — A Ton of Potential
Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E06 — Anchored in Stone
Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.
